hero.label: Introduction
hero.eyebrow: a tiny vessel of big ideas
hero.lede: I am a tech witch and a child of the internet. Join me as I try to reclaim the artistry, mystery, and stupidity of this matrix that we love.

bio.title: just a smol death
bio.nowPlaying: Cute without the E by Taking Back Sunday
bio.body:
Hello 👋 my name is M.K. Muere - my last name means death! 💀 I am a web developer from Toronto, ON. My specialty is leading agile tech teams, and building unique yet accessible e-commerce experiences.

Formality aside, I practice in digital witchcraft and general internet buffoonery.
